component.summary: Live TV, movies and series from your IPTV source
البث المباشر والأفلام والمسلسلات من مصدر IPTV الخاص بك
Live-TV, Filme und Serien aus Ihrer IPTV-Quelle

description.p: MoPlayer is the media player MoOS ships with: a cinematic IPTV client for live television, films and series. It connects to an Xtream Codes account or an M3U playlist, and it plays through libmpv — the same engine the system already provides — so it adds no codec stack of its own.

ul.li: Live television with a programme guide, categories and favourites
Films and series, with seasons, episodes and resume
Continue watching, watch history and a global search
Full playback controls with aspect, speed, audio and subtitle tracks
Automatic stream recovery with visible status and manual retry
Media keys and the Plasma media applet, over MPRIS
Arabic, English and German, with a full right-to-left interface

description.p: MoPlayer هو مشغّل الوسائط الذي يأتي مع نظام MoOS: تطبيق IPTV سينمائي للبث المباشر والأفلام والمسلسلات. يتصل بحساب Xtream Codes أو بقائمة M3U، ويشغّل عبر libmpv — المحرّك الذي يوفّره النظام أصلاً — فلا يضيف أي حزمة ترميز خاصة به.

MoPlayer ist der Medienplayer, den MoOS mitliefert: ein kinoreifer IPTV-Client für Live-Fernsehen, Filme und Serien. Er verbindet sich mit einem Xtream-Codes-Konto oder einer M3U-Playlist und spielt über libmpv ab — die Engine, die das System ohnehin bereitstellt.
A redesigned cinematic home and a complete playback control deck, with aspect modes, playback speed, audio and subtitle selection, bounded reconnection, and single-instance URL forwarding.
The first release that ships inside the MoOS image.
